changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6496-toast-button-keys.md`

- names `renderers/feedback/toast.tsx` → `packages/components/src/renderers/feedback/toast.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `renderers/feedback/toast.tsx` renders a `ANGLE-BRACKETS(Button)` that raises the toast, and reads two keys off the node to do it: `variant={schema.buttonVariant}` and `{schema.buttonLabel || 'Show Toast'}`. `ToastSchema` declared **neither**, on the TS face or in the `@object-ui/types/zod` mirror. The registration's own designer `inputs` offered `buttonLabel` (with `defaultValue: 'Show Toast'`), so the designer shipped a control for a key the published type did not have; `buttonVariant` was read by the renderer and named by nothing at all. `SonnerSchema` — the sibling with the identical trigger mechanism — declared both all along, so only one of the two components was expressible.

### `.changeset/6541-sonner-button-variant-enum.md`

- names `renderers/feedback/sonner.tsx` → `packages/components/src/renderers/feedback/sonner.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **Why the wide face was wrong and not merely wide.** `renderers/feedback/sonner.tsx` passes the value straight into `ANGLE-BRACKETS(Button variant={…})`, whose vocabulary is exactly those six keys of `buttonVariants`. Measured on `cva` 0.7.1, an unrecognised key contributes **no** variant class, and `defaultVariants` applies only when the value is absent *or falsy*:

### `.changeset/8338-retire-toast-action.md`

- names `renderers/feedback/toast.tsx` → `packages/components/src/renderers/feedback/toast.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **What was wrong.** The two faces shared nothing, and one of them had no JSON inhabitant at all. `packages/types/src/feedback.ts` declared `action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void }` — both members REQUIRED and `onClick` a function, so a JSON document could omit the key but never author it — while `packages/types/src/zod/feedback.zod.ts` declared `z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])`, a node or a list of nodes. Disjoint accept sets, one of them empty: the same document got a green `safeParse` and a `tsc` refusal, and no spelling satisfied both. `renderers/feedback/toast.tsx` read NEITHER — it reads `variant`, `title`, `description`, `duration`, `buttonVariant`, `className` and `buttonLabel`, and the file has exactly one `ComponentRegistry.register` call, so the zero is a reading and not a failed scan.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a claim that was born false (a changeset this change adds is excluded by construction), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `cf601fff6` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1116 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1621 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/35206266120)

## ✅ ACCEPT — objectui#9668 · ⛔ **我的派发令在字面上是错的**,dev 按意图执行并申报 · ⛔ 落地待 CI

Reviewed **in seat** by the dispatching `domain:ui` seat, `session_012EpHzwH4wTy5sd7ibkD2yq`。`Clause-②: no`。

### 前检

| leg | reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | draft,base `main`,首行 **`Fixes #7316`**,**5 文件 +274/−6** |
| carriers | `check-clause2-carriers --pair 9668` **exit 0**,⛔ 无 widening tell |

| `mcp_calls` | **0**;2 次 REST 写;⛔ 零标签写入(PR 上两个标签是 labeler 的,dev 如实报告并未碰) |
| Clause-② 自核 | diff 里 `^\+export` **零命中** ⇒ ⛔ 无新导出符号。⚠️ 报告里**缺** `clause_2` 字段 —— 派发令要求交付时重测,下见 |

### ⛔⛔ 我的派发令那条界在**字面上**是错的

我写的是「两个 registry 各补一条 **`type: 'select'`**」,原样承自分诊席 `5548437178`。

本席核实 `packages/types/src/base.ts:543` 的 `ComponentInputControlType`,**十一个成员逐个打印**:`string` `number` `boolean` `enum` `array` `object` `color` `date` `code` `file` `slot`。

```
'select' 命中: 0
'enum'   命中(亮对照): 1
```

⇒ ⛔ **`type: 'select'` 会是注册点上的 tsc 错误,外加一次具名的 Zod 解析拒绝。**

⭐ dev 按**意图**(封闭列表)而非**字面**执行,用了 `type: 'enum'` + 一个 `enum` 数组 —— 并且**申报了偏离**,⛔ 没有默默照抄也没有默默改掉。而那个形状**更严格**:`enum` 是 `validateTree` 精确判定的那一臂,且在 **error** severity 作答。姊妹键 `variant` 在这同两个节点上一直就是这个形状(`toast.tsx:42` / `sonner.tsx:52`)。

⚠️ ⛔ **这条错误经过了两个席位**:分诊席写下,本席原样带进派发令,⛔ 谁都没有去核 `select` 是不是那个联合的成员。⇒ 本班第 **12** 次「把报告的措辞带进耐久产物而不重导它所断言的东西」,而这次的耐久产物是**一条派发令**。

### ⭐⭐ 卡自己的收尾建议是**假的**,而这是本轮最有用的发现

卡写着「declare it … and **let the existing inputs parity gates take it from there**」。

⛔ 不会。`registry-inputs-spec-parity` 的判定 population 派生自 `@objectstack/spec` 的 `ComponentPropsMap` —— 实测 17.4.0 有 **45** 条,**toast 与 sonner 都不在其中**(亮对照:`page:header` **在**);该测试文件对这两个节点**只字未提**(亮对照:同一次读里 `record-picker` 提及 **10** 次)。

⇒ ⭐ **声明这个 input 并不会把这个键交给那族门禁。** 该族在修复**前后**都沉默 —— 341 passed / exit 0,三种状态下日志里**一次都没出现** `buttonVariant`。

⇒ 这正是修复**自带 pin** 的理由。而那个 pin 的写法也对:**从两个 Zod mirror 读期望词表**,⛔ 不是把六个 token 再抄一遍。

⚠️ 这条要交给 **objectui#7268**(tooltip 姊妹窄卡):它带着**同一句**收尾建议,会撞上同一个形状。

### ⭐ P2 第三次证伪

卡 `:175`/`:255`(测于 `67dadd6`)→ 分诊 `:179`/`:259`(测于 `a472b07`)→ 真值 **`:336`/`:641`**(本席在 `origin/main` 复核)。⇒ ⭐ **同一对地址已漂三次。** dev 按内容定位并报出第三次读数,而不是继承第二手的。

### ⭐⭐ 消融挣出了一个真实修复,而不只是红绿

**Leg A**(只删 toast 那条):pin 10 failed / 8 passed,**零条失败点名 sonner** ⇒ 两个 registry 是**各自独立的面**,对一个的修复 ⛔ 不被记成对两个的修复。

⭐ 而 Leg A 顺带暴露了**三条空洞通过的断言**:在一个**空**的 declared list 上,空列表不含陷阱、不拒绝任何值、且等于另一个空列表 ⇒ 三条都绿得毫无内容。各自补上「先断言词表非空」,那是第二个 commit。⇒ ⭐ **消融的价值在这里不是让红出现,是让一条本来就假绿的断言现形。**

**Leg B**(两条都删):两个文件与 base **逐字节相同**(`git diff` 对 base 报 0 文件差异)⇒ 那**就是** before 态;pin 17 failed / 1 passed,幸存的那条是不读 registry 的纯 `buttonVariants` 陷阱测量。

### ⭐ 陷阱 2 的负控制,两个陷阱各有**不同的**机制

- `buttonVariants('primary')` 等于**未识别键**的输出 ⇒ 完全没有 variant class;
- `buttonVariants('')` 等于 `buttonVariants('default')`,⛔ **不是**未识别键的输出 —— 空串 falsy,cva 落回 `defaultVariants`。

⇒ ⭐ 两个陷阱看起来是同一个,机制不同,而 dev 分别量了。声明的 enum 两个都表达不出来;经真实 manifest validator,每个节点对每个陷阱各答**恰好一条** invalid-enum 诊断、error severity,对已声明值沉默,且**不再**把该键报成 unknown-prop(亮对照:一个未声明的探针键**仍然**被报)。

### ⭐ 两条申报,都对

1. **一处 diff 加宽,申报而非静默**:`scripts/__tests__/check-component-surface-parity.test.ts` 把**本卡的形状**引为「omission 是合法的」那条断言的**活标本** ⇒ 解决标本会让那族里发布假 prose。它改了注释说标本已 settled,⛔ **保留** fixture 与断言(subset 规则不因一个标本被修而退休),该文件 42 tests 仍绿。
2. **新拒绝面已申报**,⛔ 没当纯修复卖:在 html/jsx page tier,error severity 会让**整页**渲染失败 ⇒ 一个写了六个之外值的节点现在会让它的页面失败,而不是渲染一个无色按钮。⭐ **爆炸半径实测**:全仓所有 `buttonVariant` 值都是 `destructive` 或 `outline`,都在六个之内;集合外的只有描述那个陷阱的 docblock 与 changeset 散文。

### ⚠️ 一处交付瑕疵,记下

报告里**没有** `clause_2` 字段,而派发令要求交付时重测。本席自核:diff 里 `^\+export` **零命中**,且这是一次**收窄**(新拒绝)⛔ 不是放宽 ⇒ `no` 站得住。⚠️ 但那是本席替它做的,⛔ 不是它交的。

### ⛔ 落地待 CI

工作 **ACCEPTED**。⛔ 本次不落:**6 项仍 pending**,0 red。本席在翻转那一刻重读 CI,⛔ 永不从评论继承 —— 包括本条。
